string-array.item: Fill every row, column and 3×3 box with the numbers 1 to 9, each exactly once.
Jot pencil notes, undo any move, and take up to 5 clues on each level if you get stuck.
Nothing is checked while you play. Press Submit when you think you have it and we will show you what to fix.
Climb 10 levels, earn up to 3 stars on each, and challenge a friend to beat your time on the same puzzle.

string-array.name: about_bodies
string-array.item: Rovatics Sudoku is the classic number puzzle. Fill the 9×9 grid so that every row, every column and every 3×3 box contains the numbers 1 to 9 exactly once. There are 10 levels, and every one is a different puzzle that is harder than the last.

• 10 levels, each a unique puzzle
• Pencil notes and unlimited undo
• Up to 5 clues on every level
• 1–3 star ratings and best times
• Challenge a friend: share a link to the same puzzle
• Celebrations, encouragement, sounds and haptics (all can be muted)
• Free, with no ads and no account

1. Tap a cell, then tap a number. Turn on Notes to pencil in possibilities.
2. Nothing is checked while you play.
3. Press Submit when the grid is full. Mistakes are highlighted so you can fix them.
4. Stuck? Take a clue, and the game fills in one number for you.
After you finish a level you can share a link. Your friend opens it in any web browser, plays the exact same puzzle and sees how their time compares to yours.
